officialLinks.label: Grades, grade values, GPA formula, precision and special marks
Transfer credit and ASU cumulative GPA

helpIntro: Arizona State University uses semester-hour weighting with A+ = 4.33, A = 4.00, A- = 3.67 and the standard plus/minus values. Enter ASU graded hours and grades to estimate semester or cumulative GPA.
helpNote: For standard undergraduate ASU work from fall 2004 forward. The calculator preserves A+ at 4.33 honor points but caps cumulative GPA at 4.00. Transfer grades are excluded. Repeat Impact is not offered because ASU replacement depends on cohort, eligibility and a 12-hour limit.
helpExample: A 3-credit A+ earns 12.99 honor points; a 3-credit B- earns 8.01. Together, 21.00 ÷ 6 = 3.50.

gradeExplanations.A+: A+ = 4.33 grade points; cumulative ASU GPA is capped at 4.00.
gradeExplanations.EN: EN is treated as E for GPA, repeatability, and academic standing.
gradeExplanations.EU: EU is treated as E for GPA purposes.
gradeExplanations.XE: XE is treated as E for GPA, repeatability, and academic standing.
gradeExplanations.P: P earns hours but is not used to compute GPA.
gradeExplanations.Y: Y is satisfactory and is not included in GPA.
gradeExplanations.W: W earns no credit or grade and is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.X: X is audit and is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.I: Incomplete is excluded until resolved; undergraduate I can become E after one calendar year.
gradeExplanations.NR: No Report is temporary and excluded until a final grade posts.
gradeExplanations.Z: Course in Progress is excluded until an applicable final grade posts.

specialTypes.name: ASU course, standard undergraduate grading
specialTypes.note: Use for ASU undergraduate courses on the standard fall-2004-and-later grading scale.

specialTypes.name: External transfer coursework
specialTypes.note: Transfer grades/honor points can matter for admission, but ASU cumulative GPA is based only on ASU coursework.

specialTypes.name: Sandra Day O’Connor College of Law course
specialTypes.note: Law has its own grading context; do not force it through this undergraduate profile.

specialTypes.name: Graduate-career or graduate-policy record
specialTypes.note: Graduate students have separate GPA definitions and progress rules.

repeatPolicy.note: Repeat Impact is not offered. ASU repeat treatment depends on admission cohort, eligibility and the 12-hour replacement limit; verify your record with the Registrar.
